# Plotraa

> Plotraa is a WhatsApp-native real estate CRM for property dealers, built by Wayne E Solutions (Ludhiana, Punjab, India). Dealers send plot size, location and price on WhatsApp, and Plotraa creates a shareable property listing with satellite imagery and a traced plot boundary, then tracks buyer leads.

- Plans: two categories, Basic and Basic with Leads (monthly, no lock-in)
- Invite-only: dealers are onboarded city by city
- Plotraa is a listing and lead-management tool, not a party to property transactions

## Pages

- [Home](https://plotraa.com/): List a property by sending a WhatsApp message. Plotraa creates a shareable listing with satellite imagery and plot boundary, and tracks every buyer lead.
- [How It Works](https://plotraa.com/how-it-works): Send plot size, location and price on WhatsApp. Plotraa's AI builds a property page with satellite imagery and boundary, and sends every buyer lead to you.
- [Pricing](https://plotraa.com/pricing): Monthly Plotraa plans for property dealers in two categories: Basic and Basic with Leads. WhatsApp listings, AI property extraction, lead inbox and team access. No lock-in.
- [Team](https://plotraa.com/team): Plotraa is built by Wayne E Solutions, a small team in Ludhiana, Punjab, building the WhatsApp-native CRM that property dealers actually use every day.
- [Legal](https://plotraa.com/legal): Plotraa's terms and conditions, privacy policy, refund and cancellation policy, cookie policy, acceptable use policy and grievance contact information.
- [Request Access](https://plotraa.com/request-access): Request a Plotraa account for your property business. We onboard dealers city by city with a real setup call and review new requests within one working day.
